definitions.full: H4879. meshugah [ מְשׁוּגָה ] noun feminine error ; — suffix מְשׁוּגָתִי Job 19:4 (? read מְשֻׁגָּתִי ). שׁוֺד Job 5:21 van d. H., for I. שֹׁד q. v. below שׁדד . [ שׁוּד ] verb, יָשׁוּד Psa 91:6 see שׁדד .
